events.title: Python 3.13 released
events.summary: Python 3.13 shipped on October 7, 2024 with an experimental free-threaded build, improved REPL, and JIT compiler groundwork.
events.about: Python 3.13's optional nogil mode lets threads run truly in parallel on multi-core CPUs — a historic change for CPU-bound Python. The new interactive REPL and colorized tracebacks improved daily developer experience while the project tested JIT for future releases.

narrative.whyChosen: 3.13's free-threading experiment could unlock multicore Python for the first time.
narrative.whyImportant: The GIL had been Python's biggest architectural limitation for parallel compute.
narrative.problemSolved: Multi-core machines could not run CPU-heavy Python workloads in parallel threads effectively.
